recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-39176 unless a future work group decision changes the CodeableReference profiling policy.
issue_request: FHIR-39176 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification for R5. It requested changing the CodeableReference narrative from SHOULD NOT to SHALL NOT because sdf-24 and sdf-25 are error-severity StructureDefinition constraints.
initial_application: Git commit b2f9914244a825465609e9fe2bf6772f68d402d8 explicitly applied FHIR-39176 on 2023-02-14 by changing source/references.html from SHOULD NOT to SHALL NOT for constraints on CodeableReference.reference and CodeableReference.concept.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists CodeableReference and maps codeablereference to the references page, so source/references.html is build-scoped. The sdf-24 and sdf-25 constraints remain error rules in source/structuredefinition/structuredefinition-StructureDefinition.xml. Later combined-branch reconciliations for FHIR-38957, FHIR-41852, and FHIR-40955 clarified or cleaned up the same paragraph while preserving the SHALL NOT rule. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-11-14 confirm the FHIR-39176 vote, and no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/references.html states that targetProfile and binding constraints declared on CodeableReference apply to CodeableReference.reference and CodeableReference.concept respectively and SHALL NOT be specified directly on .reference or .concept.
